''See also: [[Reigan Shen Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Reigan [[Shen]] is the [[Monarch]] of the [[Rosegold continent]] and the Emperor of Lions. A creature of immense ambition, he rose from humble beginnings to become a powerful leader by winning the inaugural [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned King tournament]]. He is the creator and sole practitioner of the [[King’s Key]], a unique [[Path]] involving spatial [[Authority|authority]] that allows him to access an extra-[[spatial vault]] for storing weapons, techniques, and enemies. This power stems from a [[Sage’s Remnant]] he bonded with during his youth. As a leader, [[Shen]] has successfully unified various factions—including the [[Blood Shadows]] of [[Redmoon Hall]], the [[Abyssal Palace]], the [[Silent Servants]], and the [[Stormcallers]]—and has even gathered the cults of the four [[Dreadgods]] under his banner. He is driven by a desire to bring the [[Dreadgods]] under control and has worked alongside the [[Dragon King]] toward that end. Physically, he possesses the traits of a lion, including a white-gold mane and immense strength. Throughout his life, he has navigated complex political landscapes, dealt with the aftermath of the [[Dread War]], and maintained a reputation for being a formidable combatant capable of utilizing advanced spatial treasures and specialized weaponry.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Reigan [[Shen]] is a powerfully built man with gold-tinged white hair and a beard that blends into a white-gold mane. He possesses eyes that flash gold and wears a lens covering his left eye. Additionally, he can take on a lion form.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Known as an imperialist, conqueror, and daring innovator, Reigan [[Shen]] is a glory-seeker who is notorious for playing with his prey. He works to bind [[Dreadgod]] factions together and seeks to acquire [[Cradle]] by utilizing the [[Dreadgods]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Reigan [[Shen]] works with the [[Dragon King]] and [[Luminous Queen Sha Miara|Sha Miara]] to protect [[Rosegold]]. He has chosen [[Therian Nills]] and [[Yan Shoumei]] as his chosen, and he was selected by [[Subject One]]. He is a person mentioned by [[Eithan]], whom he has also sponsored and paid for expensive clothing. Reigan [[Shen]] is a target for [[Yerin]], who remembers his face from [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]], and he has fought [[Tiberian Arelius]]. He is also connected to [[Lindon]], whom he pounced on, and [[Malice]], whose support of [[Northstrider]] prevented his invasion. Additionally, he has interacted with [[Min Shuei]], [[Cladia]], [[Calan Archer]], [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]], [[Seishen Daji|Daji]], and the [[Blood Sage]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As the creator of the [[Path of the King’s Key]], Reigan [[Shen]] utilizes [[Path of the King’s Key|King's Key]] [[madra]] to control an extra-[[spatial vault]] for storing weapons, techniques, and enemies. He possesses mastery over spatial travel, can move space intuitively, and uses [[hunger madra]]. His combat repertoire includes using gold-edged portals to unleash [[Striker techniques]], employing a flight [[construct]], and utilizing various weapons such as a sun-like sword and a [[life madra]] whip.}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|After being welcomed with open arms and chosen by [[Subject One]], Reigan [[Shen]] serves as the patron of the [[Dreadgod cults]] during the [[Uncrowned King === {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Lion Monarch}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Reigan [[Shen]] serves as the [[Lion Monarch]] and possesses [[hunger madra]] that was kept within a space-locked, scripted container.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4">''Dreadgod'', chapter 4</ref> His power is such that [[Malice]] draws a comparison between him and the [[Silent King]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18">''Dreadgod'', chapter 18</ref> Acting as a lion that takes on the tiger's share of the burden, he hovered nearby to observe the battle.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19">''Dreadgod'', chapter 19</ref> He maintained an initial collection of relics and possesses an isolated space that looks like his treasure vaults.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21">''Dreadgod'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22">''Dreadgod'', chapter 22</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Rosegold and House Gray}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Reigan [[Shen]], a sacred lion of [[House Gray]] and [[House Shen]], is an [[Underlord]] of the [[Rosegold plains]] who witnessed [[Monarchs]] battling the [[Wandering Titan]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c1">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 1</ref> As a member of a species possessing [[madra]] and natural gifts, he advanced to [[Underlord]] with the aid of his elders and shared bloodline power.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c1" /> During his [[advancement]] to [[Gold]], he swallowed a [[Sage]]'s spirit and now possesses a bonded [[Remnant]] while following the [[Path]] of the [[Path of the King’s Key|King's Key]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c1" /> An intuitive mover of space, he is one of the eight [[Uncrowned]] who competed in the first [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned King tournament]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c1" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref> Although he was not favored to win his match against [[Tiberian Arelius|Tiberian]], Reigan possessed a more powerful body and soul in terms of [[madra]] potency, eventually advancing to the Overlord stage during the tournament.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c1" /> Described as the killer of [[Eithan]]'s family, he is currently weakened but is planning to assassinate [[Lindon]]'s friends.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c2">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c14">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 14</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">23</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Reigan Shen]] witnessed [[Monarchs]] battling the [[Wandering Titan]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c1" />}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|“I doubt Reigan Shen is burned at all by our tenacity,” Eithan said, and Veris paled.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c17" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“Victory,” the Ninecloud Soul announced, “to Yan Shoumei of Redmoon Hall, chosen of Reigan Shen.”<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c6" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“It can be hard for some of us to keep our impulses in check,” Reigan Shen said, sipping his glass of wine.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c21" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Reigan Shen turned to the Blood Sage. “Ready yourself,” he said.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“The dragon is the obvious target, but then Reigan Shen is the one binding the Dreadgod factions together.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28" />}}
